title: Legal Fulfillment Progression: Print Carrier Shipping Label
invariantSummary: In state 'inventory_allocated', generating a shipping label is legal if a valid logistics carrier is supplied. The proposal satisfies the 'hasValidCarrier' guard and advances to 'label_printed'.
